primaryContext.candidateText: For the saying which he cried by the LORD’s word against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely happen.”

primaryContext.candidateText: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
primaryContext.fixedText: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

primaryContext.candidateText: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
primaryContext.fixedText: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

primaryContext.candidateText: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
primaryContext.fixedText: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

primaryContext.candidateText: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
primaryContext.fixedText: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

primaryContext.candidateText: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.
primaryContext.fixedText: Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. The famine was severe in Samaria.

primaryContext.candidateText: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.
primaryContext.fixedText: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and chariots. He went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.

primaryContext.candidateText: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”
primaryContext.fixedText: Ben Hadad sent to him, and said, “The gods do so to me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me.”

primaryContext.candidateText: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”
primaryContext.fixedText: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Ben Hadad sent out, and they told him, saying, “Men are coming out from Samaria.”

primaryContext.candidateText: Ben Hadad said to him, “The cities which my father took from your father I will restore. You shall make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria.” “I”, said Ahab, “will let you go with this covenant.” So he made a covenant with him and let him go.

primaryContext.candidateText: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.
primaryContext.fixedText: The king of Israel went to his house sullen and angry, and came to Samaria.

primaryContext.candidateText: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
primaryContext.fixedText: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

primaryContext.candidateText: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
primaryContext.fixedText: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

primaryContext.candidateText: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
primaryContext.fixedText: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting each on his throne, arrayed in their robes, in an open place at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.

primaryContext.candidateText: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
primaryContext.fixedText: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

primaryContext.candidateText: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.
primaryContext.fixedText: They washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood where the prostitutes washed themselves, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke.

primaryContext.candidateText: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
